title: Dima and Continuous Line
statementMd:
Dima and Seryozha live in an ordinary dormitory room for two. One day Dima had a date with his girl and he asked Seryozha to leave the room. As a compensation, Seryozha made Dima do his homework.

The teacher gave Seryozha the coordinates of $*n*$ distinct points on the abscissa axis and asked to consecutively connect them by semi-circus in a certain order: first connect the first point with the second one, then connect the second point with the third one, then the third one with the fourth one and so on to the $*n*$-th point. Two points with coordinates $(*x*_{1}, 0)$ and $(*x*_{2}, 0)$ should be connected by a semi-circle that passes above the abscissa axis with the diameter that coincides with the segment between points. Seryozha needs to find out if the line on the picture intersects itself. For clarifications, see the picture Seryozha showed to Dima (the left picture has self-intersections, the right picture doesn't have any).

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cb64a010d814d4ba3c51fbb162b9b1636023e5dd.png)

Seryozha is not a small boy, so the coordinates of the points can be rather large. Help Dima cope with the problem.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{3})$. The second line contains $*n*$ distinct integers $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$ $( - 10^{6} ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6})$ — the $*i*$-th point has coordinates $(*x*_{*i*}, 0)$. The points are not necessarily sorted by their $*x*$ coordinate.

## Output

In the single line print "`yes`" (without the quotes), if the line has self-intersections. Otherwise, print "`no`" (without the quotes).

## Note

The first test from the statement is on the picture to the left, the second test is on the picture to the right.
statementZhMd:
Dima 和 Seryozha 两人住在一间普通的双人宿舍里。一天，Dima 要和女朋友约会，于是他请 Seryozha 离开房间。作为补偿，Seryozha 让 Dima 帮他做作业。

老师给了 Seryozha 数轴上的 $*n*$ 个不同点，并要求按照一定顺序用半圆依次连接它们：首先连接第一个点和第二个点，然后连接第二个点和第三个点，再连接第三个点和第四个点，以此类推，直到第 $*n*$ 个点。坐标为 $(*x*_{1}, 0)$ 和 $(*x*_{2}, 0)$ 的两个点，应该用一个位于数轴上方、且直径与两点间线段重合的半圆连接。Seryozha 需要判断图中的线是否会与自身相交。具体情况请参见 Seryozha 给 Dima 展示的图片（左图中存在自交，右图中不存在自交）。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cb64a010d814d4ba3c51fbb162b9b1636023e5dd.png)

Seryozha 已经不是小孩子了，因此点的坐标可能会非常大。请帮助 Dima 解决这个问题。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{3})$。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个互不相同的整数 $*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}, ..., *x*_{*n*}$ $( - 10^{6} ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{6})$，第 $*i*$ 个点的坐标为 $(*x*_{*i*}, 0)$。这些点不一定按照 $x$ 坐标排序。

## 输出格式

如果这条线存在自交，在一行中输出 `yes`（不含引号）；否则输出 `no`（不含引号）。

## 说明

题面中的第一个测试对应左图，第二个测试对应右图。
